phrases.latin: Age spectā postēs cujus modī, quantā firmitāte factī et quantā crassitūdine.
phrases.english: Come, look at the doorposts: what they’re like, how solidly made, and how thick.

phrases.latin: Postēs nōndum firmī sunt; nōlī eōs tangere.
phrases.english: The door frame isn’t firm yet; don’t touch it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 306.
